description: The Carlin family's move to Los Angeles pushes Spencer into a new social world where her connection with Ashley forces her to question assumptions about friendship, attraction and the person she wants to become.

s01e01-02.description: The Carlin family arrives in Los Angeles, where Spencer's friendship with Ashley quickly challenges the assumptions she brought from Ohio.

s01e03.description: Spencer's growing connection with Ashley becomes tangled with Aiden, while the Carlin siblings struggle to find their place in Los Angeles.

s01e04.description: Ashley warns Spencer that a new friendship may carry romantic expectations, forcing Spencer to confront feelings she has barely begun to name.

s01e05.description: Spencer tries to understand what she wants from Ashley while the people around them push relationships forward faster than certainty allows.

s01e06.description: Dating advice and mixed signals leave Spencer navigating the gap between what her friends expect and what actually feels right to her.

s01e07.description: Boundaries blur across the group's friendships and romances as Spencer and Ashley test whether their bond can remain simple.

s01e08.description: Spencer's feelings become harder to hide as family pressure and jealousy make private uncertainty increasingly public.

s01e09.description: A sudden crisis shakes the Carlins and forces Spencer, Ashley and their friends to reconsider what matters when ordinary plans disappear.

s01e10.description: Spencer faces the consequences of being more honest about herself while her family struggles with what that honesty means.

s01e11.description: The season's accumulated secrets and relationship choices collide, leaving Spencer and the people closest to her to deal with the aftermath.
